decisions.reason: A low-cost plugin close to the core offer, in a growing industry and at a hiring firm with slack, gives no shortfall signal that would prompt search for other uses of its resources.
ERP interfaces support the strategic push toward multichannel commerce and tend to bring steady client demand, so results likely meet the aspiration.
Price comparison tracking fits the firm's analytics and advertising services, and maintenance costs are low enough for the firm's slack to carry it.
This tracking plugin largely duplicates C and E, so it faces some risk of consolidation, but no clear performance shortfall is evident.
This tracking plugin also overlaps with the others, and the firm may later prune the weakest one, but a growing market and available slack favour keeping it for now.
A net price reporting plugin complements A, serves B2B shop clients and costs little to maintain within the established offer.
